summary: Alphabet's decision to raise its 2026 capital expenditure forecast to $195–$205 billion intensified concerns about runaway AI hyperscaler spending, overshadowing a strong earnings beat and dragging tech lower. Elevated oil prices — with Brent holding near $100 a barrel after Houthi tanker attacks — are adding upward pressure on rates and stressing the bond market, keeping real yields elevated and sentiment cautious across assets.
tweet: Alphabet's AI capex shock and $100 Brent crude are the twin drags this week — tech rotates lower, bonds stay under pressure, gold caught in the crossfire.
